english.note: Use 問 as the all-purpose verb for requesting information, putting a question to someone, or checking whether permission is given.

exampleSentences.english: I want to ask whether you’re free tomorrow.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我想問你聽日得唔得閒。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 man6 nei5 ting1 jat6 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for asking someone questions or seeking information.

exampleSentences.english: I want to ask you a question about what time the meeting starts.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa5 nei5 gei2 dim2 hoi1 wui2

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for asking someone a question.

exampleSentences.english: You can query me if anything is unclear.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 jau5 me1 m4 ming4 ho2 ji5 man6 ngo5
